summary: Shinhan Financial Group filed its 1Q 2026 Business Report (Form 6-K) with the SEC, summarizing its quarterly results and value-up plan. The filing updates progress on shareholder return targets: 50%+ return ratio, 10%+ ROE, and 13%+ CET1 ratio, with a share reduction of ~25 million shares completed by January 2026. No event-driven catalyst is present since this is a routine quarterly update rather than an announcement of a special situation. Filing is a standard foreign private issuer report.
